Present applicant - Vijay Sharma, son of Dharamveer Sharma, is praying for anticipatory bail in reference to FIR dated 29.06.2024 bearing FIR No. 0117 of 2024, Police Station - Pulbhatta, District - Udham Singh Nagar, wherein present applicant along with six others have been implicated for the offences punishable under Section 420 IPC.
4.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and have no concerned with the allegations, as alleged, since he was removed from the Company namely Real Reliable Agro Land Company Ltd in the year 2015.
He submits that even otherwise, he was working in the Company as a salaried employee.
He further submits that after completion of the investigation, charge sheet has been filed for the offence punishable under Section 420 IPC read with Section 3 of the Uttarakhand Protection of Interests of Depositors (in Financial Establishment)
Act, 2005.
He further submits that during investigation, he cooperate with the investigation and was not arrested, however, after filing of the charge sheet, there is an apprehension of arrest.
